bindgen/clang-sys.about: bindgen's `Unable to find libclang` panic (with the `runtime` feature) and clang-sys's own search error, which it wraps; both print clang-sys's `llvm-config` warning first when it is missing. bindgen can panic before it declares any variable, and the error text is its own, so it is a fingerprint too.

lines: *could not execute `llvm-config` one or more times*
*couldn't find any valid shared libraries matching:*`LIBCLANG_PATH`*

errors.hint: libclang is not in the sandbox; add `{opt}.nativeInputs = p: [ p.rustPlatform.bindgenHook ];`

errors.pattern: *couldn't find any valid shared libraries matching:*`LIBCLANG_PATH`*
